name: NyquistAI MedTech
description: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NyquistAI MedTech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NyquistAI MedTech to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nyquistai.com/agent/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NyquistAI MedTech MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NyquistAI MedTech provides these MCP tools: global_trial_search, usfda_company_search, usfda_device_search, usfda_guidance_search, usfda_inspection_citation_search, usfda_maude_search, usfda_recall_search, usfda_registration_search, usfda_regulation_search, and usfda_warning_letter_search.

_published_faq.name: Does NyquistAI MedTech MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: NyquistAI MedTech requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NyquistAI MedTech is developed by Nyquist Data Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
